turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. It's really nice to meet you, too. Um, I want to make sure I explain this right, so please just let me know if I'm rambling. 

I guess I'm here because things have been kind of stressful at work lately. I'm a transportation inspector. And, well, I don't want to sound like I'm just complaining or making a big deal out of nothing, because I usually try to get along great with everyone. But ever since I won this county safety award a little while back... certain people at the office have been sort of twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking me these really pointed budget questions, almost like they're trying to make me look crooked? 

And I know my supervisor says it’s just a normal review, and I really try to be a team player and listen to him, but... I can just tell there’s some kind of coordinated effort going on to discredit me. 

Is it okay that I start with that? I hope I'm explaining it in a way that makes sense.

symptom_reasoning.S019: The patient expresses a fixed belief that coworkers are coordinating an effort to discredit them, despite their supervisor stating it is just a normal review, indicating a persecutory delusion.
